source.description.zh-Hans: Tapas 有平台出品和独立作者发布的英文条漫，能读到《The Beginning After the End》等小说改编漫画。部分集数需购买或等待解锁。
source.description.zh-Hant: Tapas 有平台出品與獨立作者發表的英文條漫，能讀到《The Beginning After the End》等小說改編漫畫。部分集數須購買或等候解鎖。
source.description.en: Tapas publishes English-language comics from its studio and independent creators, including novel adaptations such as The Beginning After the End. Some episodes are paid or unlock after a wait.
